title: HMNZS Southland followed by an 800-foot USO
place_text: at sea, New Zealand navy ship

tellings.quote: New Zealand ship in the 1980s, the HMNZS Southland, had an 800- foot-long USO following it,

plain: Kevin Knuth, a physicist who once worked at NASA, the US space agency, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that in the 1980s a New Zealand navy ship, the HMNZS Southland, was followed by an underwater object about 800 feet long. He calls it a USO, short for "unidentified submerged object", the undersea version of a UFO. He tells it as one of many cases suggesting that unknown craft move through the oceans as well as the sky.
